configuration_source: Example settings for a new run, based on the public recipe; not proof of historical execution settings.

generation.variants: Cartesian product of the two randomly sampled question types and two randomly sampled difficulties
generation.passage_view: First 5000 characters, followed by truncation marker when cut

mining.score_semantics: 1 - USearch cosine distance: document-to-document cosine similarity; higher means more similar
mining.document_view: First 512 whitespace-separated words with truncation marker when cut, then capped at 4096 characters

reranker.score_semantics: v4 requests scores with use_activation=false, stores the returned raw scalar as the raw score, and computes sigmoid(raw_score) for the regular reranker score. Higher means more relevant; not asserted to be a calibrated probability.
reranker.query_selection: First nonempty distinct query encountered by canonical aggregation
reranker.candidate_view: Title plus first 500 whitespace-separated words with truncation marker, capped at 3000 characters and stripped
